summary: PHILEON Layer 3 (Returns/RMA/Refund) fully validated. 31/31 existing unit tests + 29/29 new HTTP e2e tests + full regression 1040/1041 (1 skipped, 0 failures) all green. Frontend /admin/returns renders with 9 tabs, empty state, search input, and unauth correctly redirects to /admin/login.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend routes/returns.py is clean, correctly excludes _id, uses Pydantic extra=forbid, and audit rows omit all banned secret fields (verified in serialization test).
State machine + eligibility engine + refund calculation each have focused unit tests. Refund uses ORIGINAL order snapshot cents (never trusts totals).
Locked historical order guard (PHI-20260901-4CBC5C) verified end-to-end returns 409 LOCKED_HISTORICAL_ORDER.

Double-refund guard verified via unit test (existing stripe_refund_id -> 409 REFUND_ALREADY_ISSUED). Live e2e path for this specific case not re-tested via HTTP because it duplicates the covered unit path; could be added as a future regression.

charge.refunded webhook reconciliation code (webhooks_stripe.py 502-544) is idempotent-safe (Stripe->RMA one-way, wrapped in try/except so webhook stays green). Live signature-verified webhook replay was NOT executed via HTTP because the endpoint requires a valid Stripe signature and STRIPE_MODE=test; the reconciliation logic is code-reviewed only.
Frontend AdminReturns.jsx correctly shows 9 UI tabs; backend 10th 'all' tab is API-only (admin utility), not a UI regression.
